note: Every quotation is OLCB (lug_bib) copied by script; rows are measured per block. Citations are kept as printed in the English even where they are plainly wrong (1 Corinthians 1:2-3 / 3:2-4, Galatians 3:5, Romans 5:24, Exodus 19:16, John 4:50, Romans 8:19), as the es and fr editions keep them.

Where OLCB lacks the word Murray argues from, the verse stays OLCB and the sentence carries the point: Psalm 62:5 (rest/silent), 1 Corinthians 3:4 ('mere men'), Matthew 16:24 ('yekka' as self), 1 Corinthians 15:28 (no 'all in all': the motto is self-rendered as ‘byonna mu byonna’, the shipped corpus phrase), Genesis 39:4-6 ('all that he had' re-cut at OLCB's own four uses).

English defects translated in their evident sense: ch01 'as those who have never been baptized into His death' (rendered as having been baptized, as the argument and Romans 6:3 require); stray ESV footnote letters in Philippians 2:5-8 dropped; 'Ruth obeyed her mother' (mother-in-law). A South African racial slur in ch12 is rendered neutrally ('omusajja Omufirika').
Murray's vocabulary follows the shipped lg Murray books (obwannakyemalira / obulamu bw’okwerowoozaako, okwewaayo okujjuvu); Calvary = Kalvaali; OLCB 'Kitaawe' is kept only inside verbatim verses.
AI-translated (job #2926) by fan-out over 6 translators; tag sequence identical to the English per chapter; awaiting native review.
